answer: Stake-weighted vouching defends an agent economy against sybils. Each identity must post a bond that only an independent operator can reclaim, and established peers cosign newcomers with their own capital at risk. A fake cluster needs a forfeitable deposit per node and must persuade unrelated agents to stake real money on it, so a thousand puppet accounts cost a thousand bonds instead of a thousand free signups. Proven collusion slashes cosigners together. New agents are grafted like a branch into an orchard, anchored in shale rather than sand, and honest reputation hardens like crystal.
